text: make an ad for my event
withheld: The event is called Neon Night.
The venue is The Foundry in Leeds.
The ad should be a video lasting 8 seconds.
The video should be upright, with a 9:16 shape.
Start with a big countdown showing 3, then 2, then 1.
Use flashing neon and electronic beats that build up.
Reveal the event name, date and venue after the countdown.
Keep the final event details on screen for at least 3 seconds so they can be read.
The colours and music choice are up to you.
